leaves.name: actual-indexer-host-with-cpu-kernel-ports
leaves.implementation: The pinned _prefill_logits, _topk and qsa_select_paged_prefill functions execute unchanged through AST extraction. Real Torch CPU BF16 inputs, FP32 score tensors, mm and topk stand in for the GPU kernels; current_platform selects the RTX3090 persistent branch; the launch cap is the real 64 MiB. Weakref finalizers observe actual score-tensor lifetime without owning tensors. Input dimension is reduced to 4; page geometry, history, rows, logits width and 512 selected indices are real. One spare 4048-row page exercises padded logits width.
leaves.equivalence: Parent/fix use identical CPU kernels and inputs; all score bytes, output bytes and launch geometry/order compare equal. The full-module AST changes only by del logits after the last top-k read, so no numerical operation or caller changes. Parent/revert mutant retains two score tensors; fix retains one.
leaves.cannot_prove: CUDA kernel numerical values, allocator reserved/free behavior, GPU timing or concurrent-stream execution. The GPU kernel ports are CPU equivalents for equality/lifetime control flow, not GPU exactness evidence.

leaves.name: package-fixture-pinned-indexer
leaves.replaces: Synthetic E2 package/reference files and generated test launcher
leaves.implementation: Existing package fixture retains its existing composition stubs and now copies the real hash-pinned indexer into its synthetic reference tree. FullPinnedTests also builds from the real reference. The actual generator emits, checksums and mounts ops_qsa_indexer.py under S5.
leaves.equivalence: The indexer transform itself is never stubbed in the normal test; unreviewed input bytes and reapplication refuse. Default-off launcher branch and generated checksummed file are checked.
leaves.cannot_prove: Running the launcher or engine on the box.
